sentences.text: Lavocatchampsa was an extinct genus of notosuchian mesoeucrocodylian found in the Late Cretaceous Kem Kem Beds of Morocco.
This genus contains only one species, Lavocatchampsa sigogneaurusselae.
Scientists Martin and de Lapparent de Broin named the genus in 2016.
Taxonomists place Lavocatchampsa within the family Candidodontidae.
This animal lived during the Albian to Cenomanian stages, from 106.3 to 93.9 million years ago.
